headline: [Indian Stocks] Fall Amid Rising International Oil Prices and Government Bond Yields... Longest Decline in 11 Months
summary: The Sensex 30 index fell 0.42% to 76,909.68 points and the Nifty 50 fell 0.32%, extending a decline amid higher oil prices and government bond yields in the US and elsewhere.
why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the benchmark indexes of Indian equities, so their moves reflect sentiment toward the country's largest listed companies. Oil prices matter to India because it is a major energy importer.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The Nifty 50 fell 0.32% in the same session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher international oil prices and rising government bond yields, including US yields, dampened investor sentiment toward risky assets worldwide, according to the report.
